parameters.query:
-- Drop existing table and recreate with correct structure
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS due_diligence_reports;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS company_data;

CREATE TABLE company_data (
    id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    company_id VARCHAR(255) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    company_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    folder_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    content TEXT NOT NULL,
    processed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE due_diligence_reports (
    id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    company_id VARCHAR(255) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    company_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    introduction_engagement_context TEXT,
    methodology_reliability_levels TEXT,
    company_overview TEXT,
    business_model_unit_economics TEXT,
    products_technology TEXT,
    target_market_competitive_set TEXT,
    financials_multi_year TEXT,
    cash_burn_runway TEXT,
    revenue_quality_client_cohorts TEXT,
    partnerships_ecosystem TEXT,
    intellectual_property TEXT,
    legal_regulatory TEXT,
    governance_board_effectiveness TEXT,
    capital_structure_dilution TEXT,
    risk_matrix_mitigations TEXT,
    gaps_uncertainties_disclaimers TEXT,
    scenario_analysis TEXT,
    strategic_options TEXT,
    recommendations_next_steps TEXT,
    source_map_integrity_log TEXT,
    comprehensive_report_url TEXT,
    status VARCHAR(100),
    created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (company_id) REFERENCES company_data(company_id)
);

-- Get the AI-generated Section 1 content from the S1 subworkflow
-- Return empty result if no AI content exists yet (don't stop workflow)
SELECT 
  COALESCE(company_id, '{{ $node["Save Company Data"].json.company_id }}') as company_id,
  COALESCE(company_name, '{{ $node["Save Company Data"].json.company_name }}') as company_name,
  introduction_engagement_context,
  COALESCE(status, 'pending_ai_generation') as status,
  COALESCE(created_at, NOW()) as created_at
FROM (
  SELECT 
    company_id,
    company_name,
    introduction_engagement_context,
    status,
    created_at
  FROM due_diligence_reports 
  WHERE company_id = '{{ $node["Save Company Data"].json.company_id }}'
    AND introduction_engagement_context IS NOT NULL
    AND status = 'section1_complete'
  ORDER BY created_at DESC 
  LIMIT 1
) as report_data
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  '{{ $node["Save Company Data"].json.company_id }}' as company_id,
  '{{ $node["Save Company Data"].json.company_name }}' as company_name,
  NULL as introduction_engagement_context,
  'pending_ai_generation' as status,
  NOW() as created_at
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM due_diligence_reports 
  WHERE company_id = '{{ $node["Save Company Data"].json.company_id }}'
    AND introduction_engagement_context IS NOT NULL
    AND status = 'section1_complete'
)
LIMIT 1;

parameters.description: Call this tool to generate Section 1 of the due diligence report. This tool will retrieve company data from database and use AI to generate professional Section 1 content, then save it back to the database.
